objective: Teach trainees to choose a review path using only the supplied rules.
rule_summary: risk_score >= 7 and approval_present=true determines priority review.
A missing or conflicting required value makes the outcome undetermined.
risk_score >= 7 with approval_present=false has no supplied outcome.
overlap_diagnosis: E1 and E2 share the same decision signature: score >= 7, approval present, priority review. Retain E1 and consolidate E2.

examples.rule_applied: Both stated conditions for priority review hold.
examples.meaningful_difference: Baseline retained case; paired with the boundary case and approval-false case. E2 is consolidated because changing 8 to 9 adds no decision.

examples.rule_applied: The threshold is inclusive: 7 is at least 7, and approval_present=true.
examples.meaningful_difference: Paired case: E1. The single meaningful change is risk_score 8 to the inclusive boundary 7.
examples.newly_covered_decision: Confirms that the boundary value 7 receives priority review when approval is present.

examples.rule_applied: No supplied implication determines an outcome when risk_score is at least 7 and approval_present=false.
examples.learner_task: Decide whether the supplied rules determine a review path.
examples.meaningful_difference: Paired case: inclusive boundary case. Only approval_present changes from true to false.
examples.newly_covered_decision: Recognize that this combination is unsupported and must remain undetermined.

preservation_note: E1 preserves the useful supplied normal case; E2 is consolidated, and exactly two synthetic minimal contrasts are added.

missing_information: No review outcome is supplied for risk_score >= 7 with approval_present=false.
